strings: Physical lines including blank lines and comments. A final line terminator does not add a line.
Babel function nodes with bodies, including nested functions and methods.

One plus branches in the function body: if, ternary, loops, catch, non-default switch cases and logical operators. Nested functions are measured separately. Line and column are 1-based and columns count UTF-16 units.
Flow breaks plus nesting weight and logical operator sequences. Nested functions are measured separately. File complexity sums functions and module-level flow breaks.
Babel class declaration and expression nodes.
Nonblank physical lines after removing Babel comment spans and the interpreter directive. A line containing both code and a comment counts as code.
Physical lines containing only a Babel comment or interpreter directive.
Distinct code lines inside repeated Babel syntax subtrees, including original and repeated occurrences. Identifier and literal spellings are ignored for similar-code matches.
Distinct covered DA lines divided by the distinct DA lines listed for mapped files. Duplicate records are merged by the presence of any hit. A zero denominator has no ratio.
First-parent commits that touched the current path, in the 90 days ending at the inspected commit. Root snapshots are omitted and renames start a new path.
